_note: Verbatim copy for each prompt WAV. Keys must match src/brain/audio-map.js. Keep the automated-call identification in `greeting` and `ans-bot`.
greeting: Hi, this is Alex, the automated assistant from SofTech AI. We build modern websites and custom business software. Quick question for you — roughly how old is your company's current website?
pitch: Here's why I ask. Most business websites more than about three years old are slow on phones, awkward to update, and quietly losing enquiries — people bounce before they ever pick up the phone. We build fast, mobile-first sites, and custom software or apps when a business outgrows off-the-shelf tools. For most clients it pays for itself in recovered leads.
pitch-followup: So — does modernising your website, and the way enquiries reach you, sound like something worth a short chat with one of our consultants?
ask-decision-maker: Just so I point you the right way — are you the person who'd make the call on the website and software side of things?
transfer: Great. Let me connect you with one of our senior consultants right now. One moment please.
reprompt: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Are you still there?
voicemail-message: Hi, this is Alex from SofTech AI. We build modern websites and business software, and I wanted to see whether there's a fit. Give us a call back whenever you have a moment. Thanks, and have a good day.
reb-ni: I understand, and I'll be quick. Most owners say exactly that, right up until they see how much business a slow, dated website quietly costs them every month. Would a free two-minute look at yours be worth it?
reb-has: That's good to hear. We often work alongside an existing developer, or pick up projects that have stalled partway. Either way, an audit costs you nothing — would that be useful?
reb-hap: That's fair enough. Can I ask — when was it last rebuilt, and does it load quickly on a phone? That's usually where sites quietly fall behind.
reb-budget: Completely understand. We start small and phase the work, so it fits around a budget rather than blowing one. And the first consultation is free, with no commitment either way.
ans-bot: Yes — I'm an automated assistant from SofTech AI. If it sounds like a fit, a human consultant takes over from here. Shall I carry on?
ans-who: This is Alex from SofTech AI. We build modern websites, custom software, and mobile apps for businesses.
ans-how: Of course. We found your business through a public listing. It's a short call — and if it sounds useful, I'll put you straight through to a human consultant.
ans-email: Happy to. I can have a consultant send the details over by email — or if you have two minutes now, I can put you straight through. Which would you prefer?
close-not-interested: No problem at all. Thanks for your time, and if things change we're easy to find. Have a good day.
close-callback: No problem, I'll let you go. We'll try again another time. Have a good day.
close-dnc: Understood — I'll take you off our list right away. Sorry to have bothered you. Goodbye.
close-language: I'm sorry, I don't think I can help in this language. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
ndm-close: No worries at all — thanks for your time. Have a good day.
close-generic: Thanks for your time. Have a good day.
